episode.title: The Universe's SLOWEST Particle: Photon's Journey

synopsis: A photon can take tens of thousands of years to escape the Sun's core, then just 8 minutes to reach Earth.
narration: Deep within the Sun's core, a single photon can take tens of thousands of years to finally escape. Yet, once it breaks free, that same photon reaches Earth in a mere eight minutes. A staggering cosmic journey of contrasts.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up view deep inside the Sun's chaotic, superheated core, a single, struggling photon bouncing erratically through dense plasma, a blinding dance.
The photon finally emerging from the Sun's turbulent surface, instantly accelerating into the vacuum of space, a bright streak against the solar corona, camera tracking its rapid departure.
A clear, fast-moving visual of the photon nearing Earth, its light brilliantly illuminating the planet's atmosphere, then quickly reaching its destination, ending with a subtle, bright shimmer.

music: An ethereal, slow-building ambient track with subtle, shimmering textures, gradually gaining momentum and complexity. A distinct, accelerating pulse emerges as the photon escapes, leading to a swift, bright flourish.
